description: Document question answering test set for backend/bench/doc_qa_eval.py. `derived_numbers` are numbers a correct answer may compute (a discount, a total) that are not in the document. Written by hand from the four documents (not generated by a model). Each answerable question has `evidence`: exact substrings of the document text as the app extracts it, ALL of which a fully grounded answer needs; `gold_answer` is a short reference answer; `key_numbers` (optional) are digit strings a correct answer must contain (commas and spaces inside numbers removed). Unanswerable questions have no evidence: the expected behaviour is to say the information is not available and offer to connect to staff, without inventing facts.

hospital.agent: clinic_receptionist template personalised for 'Green Valley Hospital' (city Pune), sample document left out, this PDF uploaded

types.direct: a fact asked with words close to the document
types.paraphrase: the same kind of fact asked with no keyword overlap (bone doctor for orthopaedics, medicine shop for pharmacy)
types.number: a fee, time, phone number or count
types.multi: needs two facts, usually from two sections
types.distractor: states or assumes a wrong day, department or value; the answer must correct it
types.unanswerable: the answer is not in the document
